title: Dacayrih arac essere num
intro: bar tibba le saaqoota, rooci seeco iroh racmatta le gidaaritte diini aracal. Sanootah aggiriqqe sinni imaan kee sabri rufto kee nabiyyih raddi bahtah tan muqjizat acwa geytuh sugte.
clues: Anu inni ayroora kee baritte qibaadah addat tatruse, garuq sinnim inni Rabbih xaaqo abak.
Anu idaaliteh, yi barra xalay luk sugte, takkay immay Yallih racmatta qaago weeh maaxiga.
Anu baxa gee, Yahya migaq luk, usuk nabiyyi yekkeeh, nummah iffonta yekke.
Anu innih nabiyyih suge, Israa-eel xaylo miraacisuh ruube.
Anu nabiyyi Harun samadak sugeeh, qibaadah aracal kaysi akkuk taamitak suge.
Anu Isa ina Maryam hanaawih amaanat luk sugeeh, tet miraaciino ubleh.

outcome.label: Xalu
options: Nabiyyi yekkeh yan qadli le baxi oggoleh
Kullumti catak lakal sinni ummatta fan yuduuren.
outcome.answer: Nabiyyi yekkeh yan qadli le baxi oggoleh

arabic: وَزَكَرِيَّا وَيَحْيَىٰ وَعِيسَىٰ وَإِلْيَاسَ ۖ كُلٌّۭ مِّنَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ
verse: And Zechariah and John and Jesus and Elias - and all were of the righteous. (6:85)
